keyPhrases.text: I can attest that, in this production—more than in any other I've seen—the parallels between Sally's experience and that of today's young women are uncanny
I've seen and loved other productions of "Cabaret"
Gayle Rankin powerfully embodies what is undeniably a Sally of 2024
I resonate more with this Sally than with any that have come before
Rankin's performance of Sally deeply affected each and every one of them
this Sally feels like our Sally

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic praise for the direction and lead performance. Author explicitly states they 'loved' the production and found it more resonant than previous versions. While defending against other critics' reservations, the review is clearly recommending and celebrating this production as particularly meaningful and well-executed.
